blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Super Typhoon Champi is expected to enter the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) on Tuesday, Oct. 20, and will be named Rosal, bringing strong winds and heavy rains to northern Luzon and Bicol, according to the weather bureau. In its 5 a.m. bulletin on Sunday, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said Champi intensified into a super typhoon over the sea near Guam. As of 4 a.m., it was last estimated to be 2,230 kilometers east of southeastern Luzon, moving west-northwestward at 25 kilometers per hour (kph).
